caveats.enter_probe_navigated_away: On 02-admin-pos, the Enter-activation probe triggered router navigation, pushing the SPA to /admin/dashboard. Subsequent admin tests inherited the dashboard URL because Playwright reused the page context; their tab_walk thus audited admin sidebar+topbar+main on dashboard, not their target view. The findings remain valid for the admin shell (which is the dominant focus surface) but the deep-page-specific issues for /admin/pos, /admin/items, /admin/stock-rupture-dashboard were NOT separately probed.
caveats.pos_trap_location: The 3 traps detected on 02-admin-pos are on the .pos-shortcuts__cta--cash button ("💳 Encaisser") in the dashboard pos-shortcuts panel — same 3 consecutive Tabs stop on the same button, indicating a focus trap or a nested li > button structure that is not advancing focus.
caveats.kiosk_catalog_wizard_unauth: 07-kiosk-catalog and 08-kiosk-wizard URLs resolved to /login because the kiosk machine login (loginAsKiosk default kiosk-lecayenne/kiosk123) did not authenticate. Those two surfaces measured the /login page, not real kiosk catalog / wizard.
caveats.scope_match: Surfaces audited as a keyboard-nav sweep: login, kiosk idle (real), admin SPA shell (5x, dominated by dashboard chrome). POS-specific cashier-flow, KDS chef bump, admin items list, stock-rupture dashboard, kiosk catalog and kiosk wizard need a re-run with cookie-isolated browser contexts and a verified kiosk machine fixture to audit their unique focus trees.
